title: Acrylamide exposure induces neurotoxicity via the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB pathway: Evidence from network toxicology and experimental validation.
authors: Duan, Zhaoda; Yu, Chunjiao; Yu, Qiuxian; Yang, Wenjie; Zhang, Rui; Ruan, Qiaoling; Zhao, Yongfang; Yan, Shan
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨丙烯酰胺通过PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB通路诱导神经毒性的机制，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acrylamide (ACR) is a chemical compound widely used in industrial production and food processing, the underlying mechanisms of its neurotoxicity have yet to be fully elucidated. Through the integration of network toxicology, molecular docking, and experimental validation, this study systematically explored the underlying molecular mechanisms of ACR-induced neurotoxicity. Through database analysis, 183 ACR-related targets and 2725 neurotoxicity-associated targets were identified, among which 100 overlapping genes were predominantly enriched in the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway and apoptosis-related biological processes. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations suggested potential interactions between ACR and key target proteins. While causing minimal alterations in peripheral organs, ACR exposure in vivo resulted in hippocampal neuronal disorganization and Nissl body loss, indicating potential neurotoxicity. In vitro studies demonstrated that ACR not only decreased cell viability in PC12 and HT22 cells but also significantly enhanced apoptosis and inflammation, while markedly activating the PI3K/Akt and NF-kappaB signaling pathway. The significant attenuation of these effects was observed following treatment with the PI3K inhibitor LY294002. These findings suggest that ACR-induced neurotoxicity involves the coexistence and imbalance of survival and inflammatory-apoptotic signaling, providing mechanistic insight into its neurotoxic effects and a theoretical basis for potential preventive strategies.
abstract_zh: 丙烯酰胺（ACR）是一种广泛用于工业生产和食品加工的化学化合物，其神经毒性的潜在机制尚未完全阐明。通过整合网络毒理学、分子对接和实验验证，本研究系统探讨了ACR诱导神经毒性的潜在分子机制。通过数据库分析，鉴定出183个ACR相关靶点和2725个神经毒性相关靶点，其中100个重叠基因主要富集于PI3K/Akt信号通路和凋亡相关生物学过程。分子对接和分子动力学模拟提示ACR与关键靶蛋白之间存在潜在相互作用。在对周围器官引起最小改变的同时，ACR体内暴露导致海马神经元排列紊乱和尼氏体丢失，表明其潜在的神经毒性。体外研究表明，ACR不仅降低PC12和HT22细胞的活力，还显著增强凋亡和炎症反应，同时明显激活PI3K/Akt和NF-kappaB信号通路。经PI3K抑制剂LY294002处理后，这些效应显著减弱。这些发现表明，ACR诱导的神经毒性涉及生存信号与炎症-凋亡信号的共存及失衡，为其神经毒性效应提供了机制性见解，并为潜在预防策略提供了理论基础。
